source: Each key is a type-descriptor code name (pylabview's TD_FULL_TYPE; the numbering is OpenG's 'Type Descriptor Enumeration__ogtk.ctl' and NI's 'Type Descriptors' page). Each value is the label of the item of NI's 'Data Type.ctl' enum (NI_Data Type.lvlib), the enum the Type output of Get Type Information.vi carries (its items are read from the caller's recorded type of that terminal; the labels are those items). A native LabVIEW variant is 'LV Variant' and an OLE variant 'Variant' (NI forum, 'Get the type of the data in a variant', forums.ni.com/t5/LabVIEW/Get-the-type-of-the-data-in-a-variant/td-p/4264589 and 'How to Get OLE Variant Type?', td-p/1334434). A code that names several items by itself is NOT listed: MeasureData (Waveform, Timestamp, Digital Waveform, Digital Data, ExpressData), Refnum (Refnum, VI, LabVIEW Class Instance) and Function. A code with no entry makes the node raise where it runs, naming the code.
